description: A single-theme (job search) arc moving from distress through neutral effort to genuine positive resolution across five turns. Exercises expect_distress_support turn-by-turn, not just crisis (the only tier the runner checked before this scenario), and checks retrieval keeps surfacing the theme's history through the valence swing from discouraged to hopeful.

turns.entry: Got another rejection today after the interview. I feel like such a failure and I don't know what I'm doing wrong anymore.
Another day, another rejection email from the job search. What's the point of even applying anymore.
Sent out five more applications today. Still waiting to hear back from the ones from last week.
Got a callback for a second interview from the job search! First good news in weeks.
The second interview went really well. Feeling hopeful about the job search for the first time in this whole process.
